document.title: Organization

i18n.i18nString: Krátky kód pre reporty, napríklad NGF.
Ľudia neaktívnej organizácie nemôžu podávať nové tikety. Staré ďalej vidia.
Časy reakcie a vyriešenia. Tiket si ich pri podaní skopíruje.
Vidia všetky tikety tejto organizácie. Pridávajte a odoberajte poľami nižšie.
„invited" = človek si ešte z e-mailu nenastavil heslo.
Dostane pozvánku e-mailom a meno aj heslo si nastaví sám. Existujúci účet dostane len prístup.
Stratí prístup k tiketom organizácie. Účet zostane.
Zamestnanec Service Desku. Nový účet dostane pozvánku a rolu agenta.
Obnoviť stav účtov, plány a prístupy
Kto za klienta zmluvu podpíše. Príde mu e-mail z DocuSealu.

document.function: { def plan -> if (plan == null) return "No plan chosen - tickets get the default times (critical 1 h, high 2 h, medium 4 h, low 8 h to first response)." def d = plan.dataSet def h = { String k -> ((d[k]?.value ?: 0) as Number).intValue() + " h" } return "First response: critical " + h("sp_resp_critical") + ", high " + h("sp_resp_high") + ", medium " + h("sp_resp_medium") + ", low " + h("sp_resp_low") + "\n" + "Resolution: critical " + h("sp_res_critical") + ", high " + h("sp_res_high") + ", medium " + h("sp_res_medium") + ", low " + h("sp_res_low") + "\n" + "Working time: Mon-Fri " + ((d["sp_work_from"]?.value ?: 8) as Number).intValue() + ":00-" + ((d["sp_work_to"]?.value ?: 16) as Number).intValue() + ":00" }

data.title: Code
data.desc: Short code for reports, for example NGF.

data.title: Active contract
data.desc: People of an inactive organization cannot submit new tickets. They still see the old ones.

data.title: SLA plan
data.desc: Response and resolution times. A ticket copies them when it is submitted.

data.title: People with access
data.desc: They see every ticket of this organization. Add and remove people with the fields below.

data.title: Accounts
data.desc: "invited" = the person has not set a password from the e-mail yet.

data.title: E-mail of a new person
data.desc: They get an invitation e-mail and set their own name and password. An existing account just gets access.

data.title: Remove a person
data.desc: They lose access to the tickets of this organization. The account stays.

data.title: Agent e-mail
data.desc: A Service Desk employee. A new account gets an invitation and the agent role.

data.title: Signer e-mail
data.desc: Who signs the contract for the client. They get an e-mail from DocuSeal.
